syria-2011.notes: The site gives the event as 28 Sep to 1 Oct 2011 and does not say which day the contest ran; the pack date 2011-10-02 is the scoreboard's last-updated day. Site page names Oracle Machine as from Tishreen University; the standings page says Lattakia University.

syria-2024.notes: Source 1: the Wayback copy of syria.acm-acpc.org is the 2011 SCPC site (belongs to syria-2011); its crawl also holds Facebook login pages. Scoreboard s3 shows the winner with 10 solved against 12 in the standings s4; the pages do not say which is final.
